The [relative Morse companion](relative-morse-functions-and-original-handles.md#relative-morse-attachment) constructs the finite handles of the original cobordism, with their full framings and original incoming and outgoing maps. Here we construct the changes of that actual presentation needed to arrange the handles by index. The [framed slides and index-one removal](framed-handle-slides-and-index-one-removal.md#slide-index-one-cancellation) are now proved in their receiving companion. The [integral handle-chain companion](integral-handle-chains-and-signed-incidences.md#handle-six-seven) now proves the original filtration-to-homology map, every incidence sign, the full integer basis comparisons and the exact contractions in dimensions six and seven. The [higher-index framed-slide companion](higher-index-framed-slides-and-chain-maps.md#higher-slide-matrices) now realizes every elementary integral change with its full framed cobordism map and proves both neighbouring differentials using the singular-prism correction. The [receiving-dimension Whitney companion](whitney-moves-in-the-receiving-dimensions.md#receiving-whitney-flow) proves the full disk, adapted frame and supported move for the three required sheet-dimension pairs, with all original metric, orientation and framing maps retained. The [actual Morse realization and middle-cancellation companion](realizing-framed-handles-and-middle-cancellation.md#middle-six-seven-reduction) constructs the compatible function, proves the exact intersection-to-trajectory comparison and every escape and support hypothesis, and completes the simply connected smooth cobordism reductions in dimensions six and seven.
